scheme_name: Bima Yojana - Direct Benefit to Artisan
other_conditions: Must have received Shilp Guru Awards, National Awards, Merit Certificates, or similar honours
Should not be receiving similar financial assistance from other sources
Relaxation in age requirement is available for artisans with disabilities
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹8,000 per month as a monthly allowance or lump‑sum grant to eligible senior artisans.
documents_required: affidavit countersigned by a 1st Class Magistrate
